_readme: Role -> Llamanian base color. Keys are the Squoatling sprite colors; targets are the colors the Llamanian sheets are painted in (== bodyColor[0] of llamanian.species). Targets MUST be unique (make_llamanian.py asserts this). 'votes' = what the pixel diff of squoatling.png vs Llamanian_sprite.png suggested (null = role absent from the 14x35 portrait, so the pick is a guess). Edit targets here, then re-run make_llamanian.py.

CDBC89.name: Primary Fur
CDBC89.note: three-way split in the reference; E0975C is the middle fur tone

A08E58.name: Tertiary Fur
A08E58.note: not in the portrait (hair-only color); picked a tone between E0975C and A85636

AF7E55.name: Hoof / Snout
AF7E55.note: reference hands/hooves are grey, so grey family; the vote was split four ways. Check feet - the portrait's feet look brown

DED19F.name: Horn (no Llamanian equivalent)
DED19F.note: Llamanians have no horns - warm filler tone so the sheet isn't broken; erase horn pixels by hand

snap._comment: Near-duplicate strays found in the Squoatling body sheets (idle frame only). Snapped to the real key in the Llamanian copy. Source sheets are NOT modified.

variant_note: bodyColor[1:] are computed from Squoatling's variant rows: hue comes from the variant, saturation/value are scaled by (llamanian base / squoatling base) so Llamanian shading survives. See make_llamanian.py
